For non-personal use or to order multiple copies, please contact. https://www.wsj.com/finance/stocks/global-m-a-sent-surging-this-year-with-massive-ai-deals-22b7c5eb. # Global M&A Surged This Year With Massive AI Deals, Mergermarket Says. ## Counted in dollars, M&A activity from January through June was up 44% year-over-year to set a new first-half record, according to Mergermarket data. The letters "AI" lit up in white against a background of purple and blue neon lights. Blockbuster artificial-intelligence deals and a rush to lock down transactions in the U.S. powered global merger-and-acquisition volume to more than $3 trillion in the first half of 2026, even as the total number of deals receded, according to Mergermarket data. Counted in dollars, M&A activity from January through June was up 44% year-over-year to set a new first-half record.
